projects.name: starshield-forensics
projects.description: Clean-room, offline, zero-dependency Python digital forensics and pre-action evidence triage toolkit (OpenSSF Best Practices Silver #16602, CERN/Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24145804). Carves uncompacted Chromium IndexedDB/LevelDB write-ahead logs with masked Castagnoli CRC32C verification, inspects PNG/JPEG ICC containers, validates ISO-7812/ISO-13616/ISO-9362 payment identifiers, and enforces keyed pseudonymization with zero network or LLM attack surface.
